baseline.label: prod today
baseline.description: Production as deployed: the user's Sonnet 5, no reasoning settings sent (API default: effort high, adaptive thinking).

v1.label: haiku low
v1.description: Every turn forced to Claude Haiku 4.5, level low (no thinking, no effort param).

v2.label: sonnet low
v2.description: Every turn forced to Sonnet 5 at effort low, adaptive thinking.

v3.label: sonnet medium
v3.description: Every turn forced to Sonnet 5 at effort medium, adaptive thinking.

v4.label: sonnet high
v4.description: Every turn forced to Sonnet 5 at effort high, adaptive thinking, sent explicitly - the same effective setting as baseline, so it measures run-to-run noise.

v5.label: policy auto
v5.description: The reasoning policy's starting rules: general -> Haiku low; change / picked option / plain context / ambiguous -> Sonnet medium; decision -> Sonnet high.
